incident_report.incident: Over the final 200 Metres lay out and proved difficult to ride out to the finish.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Shorty after the start shifted in and made contact with VICTORY CHAMPION when being corrected by its rider B Avdulla.  Lay out over the final 200 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Shortly after the start made contact with SPEEDY POWER due to both runners shifting ground.  Near the 500 Metres was steadied when crowded by INVICTUS which shifted out and away from BUSTLING CITY (B Avdulla) when that runner shifted out before being corrected by its rider.  B Avdulla was advised to exercise more care.  After the 200 Metres was eased and shifted to the inside of INVICTUS to continue into clear running.
No report.
On jumping became unbalanced when crowded between PRIME WINISTER and BUSTLING CITY which shifted in despite the efforts of its rider.
Jumped only fairly and shortly after the start made contact with RUBY THRIVE due to both runners shifting ground.
No report.

Jumped only fairly.  Shortly after the start was then steadied when crowded between VICTORY CHAMPION which was taken in by BUSTLING CITY which shifted in despite the efforts of its rider and VIEW ALL THINGS.  In this incident PRIME WINISTER made contact with the hindquarters of VIEW ALL THINGS and lost further ground.   M F Poon stated that after jumping only fairly and being crowded shortly after the start his mount settled further back in the field than what he had been instructed.
No report.

H Bowman stated that his mount, which was having its first race start, is still immature and would derive benefit from today’s experience.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped only fairly.

Shortly after the start was bumped on the hindquarters and became unbalanced.  A Badel stated that his mount would be better suited by being stepped back up in distance for its next race start.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race found that horse to be a "roarer” which had previously been reported.
Jumped awkwardly, made contact with the right side of its starting gate and lost ground.

Prior to declaring weighed-in the Stewards considered an application from Jockey M Chadwick that his horse be declared a non-runner on the basis that it had been denied a fair start.  After taking evidence from Starter Mr A Speechley, Jockey Chadwick and Trainer C H Yip, the Stewards found that as the start was being effected SMART HIGH reared and as a consequence lost significant ground.  As the Stewards were satisfied that the Starter could not have reasonably anticipated the horse was going to rear it was declared a runner.  Before being allowed to race again, SMART HIGH will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial.
Sent for sampling post-race.

On jumping made contact with YEE CHEONG RAIDER due to both runners shifting ground.  When the pace steadied approaching the 900 Metres commenced to race keenly and got its head up when being steadied away from TEAM HAPPY.  DOUBLE BINGO then continued to race keenly throughout the middle stages and refused to settle.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

On jumping was crowded between QUICK MONEY and GIDDY UP, both of which shifted ground.  Had difficulty obtaining clear running between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres.  Between the 200 Metres and the 100 Metres was shifted to the outside of DOUBLE BINGO to obtain clear running.
From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.

Blundered shortly after the start.  C Y Ho reported that when the pace steadied approaching the 900 Metres TEAM HAPPY commenced to race keenly and as a result was steadied away from WINNING MACHINE.  He added that as a consequence TEAM HAPPY was obliged to race wide and without cover thereafter.
J Orman stated that the instructions were to hold a more forward position but when his mount jumped only fairly it did not show sufficient pace in the early stages to do so.
No report.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Shifted in on jumping and made contact with DRACO.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.

On jumping made contact with DOUBLE BINGO due to both runners shifting ground.  Held up for clear running for some distance near the 350 Metres.  Between the 250 Metres and the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.  L Hewitson stated that although his mount had some difficulty obtaining clear running in the early stages of the Home Straight it finished the race off only fairly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Between the 200 Metres and the 150 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Raced wide and without cover in the early stages and after the 900 Metres was taken wider by TEAM HAPPY.  As a consequence WAH MAY WAI WAI then raced very wide and without cover thereafter.
Slipped in the saddling stalls and fell over, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Shifted out on jumping and made contact with DRACO.
Sent for sampling post-race.

Bumped shortly after the start.  When questioned regarding his riding in the Home Straight Z Purton stated that his mount was able to show good pace in the early stages to lead the event.  He said after entering the Home Straight his mount naturally improved away from the field and established a break on other runners.  He said as he approached the 200 Metres he was concerned that the horse was commencing to peak on its run and for this reason he held the horse together whilst continuing to encourage it until near the 200 Metres.  He added after passing the 200 Metres he then placed his mount under full pressure where it responded to his riding, however, over the concluding stages was unable to hold off the eventual winer PACKING GLORY.  After considering his explanation the Stewards found the tactics adopted by Jockey Purton were reasonable in the circumstances.  Sent for sampling post-race.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 200 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when improving into a narrow run between LUCKY TWENTY and JUSTIFYING which was giving ground.
Shifted out on jumping and made contact with GOLDENTRONICMIGHTY.
No report.
Jumped awkwardly.  Shortly after the start shifted in and away from JUSTIFYING and was steadied to avoid ACE EAGLE.
On jumping was bumped by FORERUNNER and as a result shifted out and made contact with ACE EAGLE.

Approaching the 1000 Metres, when racing ungenerously, got its head up when being steadied to avoid SEA DIAMOND which, after being taken in by ACE EAGLE, then shifted in and away from ACE EAGLE slightly.  Z Purton was advised to exercise more care.  SPEEDY PATCH then continued to race ungenerously throughout the early and middle stages and near the 550 Metres got its head up when being steadied away from LUCKY TWENTY.  Had difficulty obtaining clear running for some distance near the 400 Metres.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

C Y Ho reported that his mount was disadvantaged by racing wide and without cover for the majority of the event and as a consequence gave ground in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.

M Chadwick advised that from a wide barrier he was instructed to take up a forward position but when unable to cross runners to his inside he was obliged to race very wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Trainer D A Hayes confirmed the instructions issued.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Y L Chung stated that he was instructed to settle the horse where comfortable.  He said in the early stages his mount did not show early speed and as a result settled towards the rear of the field.  Trainer A S Cruz confirmed the instructions issued.
Jumped awkwardly and lost ground.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.

Near the 200 Metres lay out and away from SUPER LOVE, resulting in its rider R Kingscote having to straighten his mount.  Near the 150 Metres then became unbalanced when bumped by SUPER LOVE which shifted out under pressure.
For some distance near the 100 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of CASA PRIMO.

Jumped awkwardly, shifted in and made contact with MAGNEMITE.  Approaching the 900 Metres was steadied to avoid FLYING SNIPER when both runners shifted ground slightly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Shifted out near the 150 Metres and was bumped.  E Brown confirmed that from the outside barrier he was instructed to take up a forward position.  Trainer C H Yip confirmed the instructions and said he issued those instructions as he was of the opinion there was not strong pace engaged in the race.
No report.

B Avdulla reported that the intention was to hold a more forward position but his mount jumped awkwardly and lost ground at the start and as a consequence settled further back than intended.  He added in the circumstances he was satisfied with his mount’s finishing effort.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Near the 100 Metres was eased to avoid GROOVY FEELING which shifted out under pressure.
Slow to begin.  Near the 900 Metres, when racing greenly, was steadied when positioned close to MASTER PHOENIX.
Noted to have blood in the mouth at the Start, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Bumped on jumping.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Jumped only fairly.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
J Orman stated that from a wide barrier he was instructed to ride the horse in a conservative manner in the early stages.  Trainer D Eustace confirmed the instructions issued.
No report.

On jumping got it head up and lost ground.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 250 Metres was steadied when disappointed for clear running between MASTER TRILLION and LOVELY MILES which shifted out.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Near the 650 Metres blundered.  A Badel stated that the instructions were to hold a more forward position but his mount jumped only fairly and raced tight to the inside of LUCKY TWIN STARS.  He said as a consequence PING HAI COMET settled further back in the field than intended.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Jumped only fairly.  Near the 550 Metres was steadied to avoid PING HAI COMET.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Near the 1000 Metres LUCKY TWIN STARS, which was racing keenly, was steadied to avoid LUCKY YEAR (A Atzeni) which shifted in when insufficiently clear.  A Atzeni was advised to exercise more care.  LUCKY TWIN STARS then raced keenly for some distance thereafter.

For some distance near the 1100 Metres raced keenly when being shifted in to obtain cover behind PACKING FIGHTER.  L Hewitson stated that the instructions were to settle where comfortable.  He said after commencing well LUCK IS BACK was able to hold an on-pace position.  Trainer P C Ng confirmed the instructions issued.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Trainer D J Hall confirmed that the instructions from a wide barrier were to go forward.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
On jumping made heavy contact with FORTUNE STAR which shifted in.  As a result GRAND PATCH shifted in and and was steadied away from ALABAMA SONG.
Made contact with a rail in the Parade Ring, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.
No report.
No report.

Bumped at the start.  Y L Chung stated that he was instructed to settle where comfortable but had expected to race in a more forward position.  He added that as his mount did not show early pace it settled further back than what he had expected.
Jumped awkwardly and then lost ground when it made contact with MULTISUPERSTAR.  In the middle stages raced keenly and after the 600 Metres was steadied away from TIN FOOK.

On jumping was bumped by HAPPY PROMISE which shifted out.  Throughout the early and middle stages raced keenly.  Approaching the 800 Metres improved close to HAPPY PROMISE and as a result was checked to avoid HAPPY PROMISE.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Shifted in abruptly at the start and was corrected by its rider.

Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  A Atzeni could offer no explanation for the horse’s disappointing performance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Made contact with a rail on the way to the Start, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Jumped awkwardly and made heavy contact with GRAND PATCH.  Shortly after FORTUNE STAR was steadied away from PRESIDENT PEGASUS which shifted in abruptly despite the efforts of its rider.  Near the 1200 Metres improved to the inside of MULTISUPERSTAR as that runner was being shifted in.  As a result FORTUNE STAR was then steadied when racing tight to the inside of MULTISUPERSTAR.  Between the 350 Metres and the 150 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running.  After being shifted to the inside of CALIFORNIA WAVES near the 150 Metres then could not be ridden out until near the 50 Metres when held up behind PRESIDENT PEGASUS.

Jumped only fairly.  When giving ground approaching the 150 Metres was steadied to avoid SILVER UP which shifted out slightly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Withdrawn at the Start by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice after it was found to be lame in its right front leg.  Before being allowed to race again, ILLUMINOUS will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
Shortly after the start was bumped by SIX PACK which shifted in.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.

L Ferraris was replaced by C L Chau (see General).  C L Chau reported that the instructions were to go forward and obtain cover.  He said when LUCKY WITH YOU jumped well he was obliged to continue forward to cross runners to his inside to avoid covering additional ground and as a result LUCKY WITH YOU settled outside the lead in the early stages.
Shifted in on jumping and was bumped.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  Sent for sampling post-race.
On jumping was hampered when taken wider by WINNING OVATION which shifted out.  When caught wide in the early stages was steadied near the 1000 Metres to obtain cover behind SIX PACK.
No report.

H Bowman stated that his mount was disadvantaged by being pressured in the lead by LUCKY WITH YOU and as a result did not finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

When questioned B Avdulla stated that from an inside barrier he was able to hold a slightly more forward position than its previous race starts.  He said throughout the middle stages he followed PATCH OF THETA and he had LITTLE PARADISE positioned to his outside.  He said whilst he contemplated shifting out from the 600 Metres he felt he was not in a position to do so as LITTLE PARADISE was racing slightly in advance of his mount and travelling well at that stage.  He said as he did not want to follow TOMODACHI KOKOROE he remained racing behind PATCH OF THETA.  He added that on entering the Home Stright when PATCH OF THETA shifted out he took the only option available to shift to the outside of PATCH OF THETA, however, became held up behind COPARTNER PRANCE near the 250 Metres when that runner commenced to give ground.  He further stated that he then looked to shift to the outside of COPARTNER PRANCE leaving the 200 Metres as he was of the opinion that COPARTNER PRANCE may continue to shift in when it was giving ground, however when COPARTNER PRANCE shifted out slightly this resulted in RAGING BLIZZARD being steadied when disappointed for clear running between COPARTNER PRANCE and PATCH OF THETA and as a result RAGING BLIZZARD did not obtain clear running between the 250 Metres and the 50 Metres.
Jumped awkwardly.

On jumping shifted out and made contact with LOCH TAY.  When questioned regarding the improved performance Trainer C S Shum confirmed that with a lack of pace engaged in the race he had instructed C L Chau to go forward with the option to lead if the pace was not strong.  He said he attributed tonight’s performance to CALL ME MAGNIFIQUE being up in distance and being able to race on the pace, particularly with the middle stages being run outside of standard time.  He further added that CALL ME MAGNIFIQUE had also derived a fitness benefit from its two previous race starts in Hong Kong.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly and shortly after the start was crowded by FALLON which shifted out despite the efforts of its rider. Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running behind LOCH TAY.  Approaching the winning post shifted out under pressure.
Between the 450 Metres and the 250 Metres was held up for clear running.
Bumped at the start.

Approaching the 400 Metres made contact with WINNING DRAGON on a number of occasions when shifting out to obtain clear running where there was not quite sufficient room to do so.  H T Mo was advised to ensure that there is sufficient room when improving into runs.  Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when being steadied to avoid NUCLEOZOR which shifted out.
Between the 450 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running.  Over the concluding stages could not be ridden out when held up behind NUCLEOZOR.

Jumped only fairly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Near the 1000 Metres was hampered when bumped and taken wider by SHAMUS STORM.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Shifted out at the start and was bumped.
Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Jumped only fairly.  Raced keenly throughout the early and middle stages.  Approaching the 1000 Metres was checked to avoid NOISY BOY and as a result shifted out, making contact with FAMILY JEWEL and taking that horse wider.  SHAMUS STORM continued to race keenly thereafter and refused to settle and as a result was allowed to stride forward where it raced very wide and without cover thereafter.  Trainer D A Hayes advised that the horse had pleased him leading into the race and he was satisfied with the position the horse had obtained in the early stages.  He said SHAMUS STORM was disadvantaged by racing too keenly throughout the middle stages which left it without a finishing effort in the Home Straight.  He added that SHAMUS STORM would now be spelled and dropped back in distance.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.

On a number of occasions approaching the 400 Metres was bumped by MIGHTY STRENGTH which shifted out to improve.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Approaching the 700 Metres got its head up when being steadied away from CHANCHENG GLORY.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Held up for clear running between the 450 Metres and the 350 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

From the outside barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Held up for clear running between the 450 Metres and the 350 Metres.  Over the concluding stages raced tight between BEAUTY JOY and KA YING GENERATION.
Over the concluding stages could not be fully ridden out when racing tight to the inside of LIGHT YEARS CHARM which shifted in slightly.
Jumped only fairly.  From a wide barrier was shifted across behind runners in the early stages.  Had difficulty obtaining clear running between the 450 Metres and the 350 Metres.

H Bowman stated that his mount was disadvantaged by racing wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

K Teetan stated that after settling back in the field his mount found it difficult to make up ground in the Home Straight due to the early and middle stages being run outside of standard time.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race which included an endoscopic examination showed a substantial amount of blood in the horse’s trachea.  Before being allowed to race again, NAUTICAL FORCE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.
No report.
A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Withdrawn on 18.6.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right hind).  Before being allowed to race again, AWESOME FLUKE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

Noted to have bled from both nostrils after the race.  As this was the second occasion that CHICKEN DINNER had bled, the horse is ineligible to run in any race conducted by the Club in the future.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped at the start.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Bumped at the start.

Jumped only fairly.  Raced keenly in the middle stages.  Near the 600 Metres shifted out and made contact with FLYING FORTRESS.  Between the 400 Metres and the 300 Metres had difficulty obtaining clear running when being shifted to the outside of CHICKEN DINNER.  As a result near the 300 Metres CROSSBORDERPEGASUS made contact with TITAN PEGASUS.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Leaving the 600 Metres URANUS STAR shifted out, resulting in FLYING FORTRESS improving to the inside of URANUS STAR.  A short distance later CROSSBORDERPEGASUS (J Orman) improved to the outside of TANG HEART, resulting in FLYING FORTRESS having to be steadied when crowded between URANUS STAR which shifted in slightly and CROSSBORDERPEGASUS.  J Orman was advised to exercise more care.  Between the 500 Metres and the 300 Metres was held up for clear running when being shifted to the outside of URANUS STAR.
For some distance near the 300 Metres was held up for clear running behind PACKING KING.
Between the 350 Metres and the 250 Metres was held up for clear running.  Approaching the 300 Metres was bumped by CROSSBORDERPEGASUS which shifted out to improve.

A Atzeni stated that the instructions were to lead but his mount did not show sufficient pace to do so.  He said in the Home Straight his mount finished the race off only fairly.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
L Ferraris was replaced by L Hewitson (see General).  Bumped heavily at the start.  Approaching the 300 Metres was bumped by FLYING HUNTER.
Jumped only fairly.

C L Chau reported that his mount hung out throughout the event and leaving the 300 Metres shifted out abruptly and as a consequence he could not ride the horse out for the remainder of the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  The racing manners of JIN SHENG were considered unacceptable.  Before being allowed to race again, JIN SHENG will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial around a bend.

Approaching the 300 Metres was hampered when taken wider by JIN SHENG.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.  H T Mo stated that when his mount jumped well it raced in a more forward position than instructed.
Jumped only fairly.  In the early stages raced keenly.  After being shifted to the inside of CROSSBORDERPEGASUS near the 900 Metres then became unbalanced when being steadied away from TEN LOVES.
Shifted out on jumping and made heavy contact with URANUS STAR.
Bumped at the start.  Raced very wide and without cover from the 700 Metres.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Jumped awkwardly, shifted out and made contact with ALMIGHTY LIGHTNING.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Stood flat-footed on jumping and lost ground.
Jumped only fairly.

From the 400 Metres became held up behind EVERYONE’S STAR and was shifted to the inside of that runner.  Near the 350 Metres was checked and shifted to the inside of SEWARD when SEWARD gave ground quickly.
Shifted out at the start and was bumped.  In the middle stages raced keenly.  For some distance approaching the 700 Metres shifted out when being steadied to avoid GLORIOUS DYNASTY.

Approaching the 700 Metres was checked when crowded between RED MAESTRO and COOL BOY which shifted out when being steadied to avoid GLORIOUS DYNASTY.  As the Stewards were satisfied that the racing manners of COOL BOY were the principal reason for the incident no action was taken.
Near the 200 Metres made contact with ALL’S WELL when improving between ALL’S WELL and EVERYONE’S STAR.

On jumping was crowded between COOL BOY and GLORIOUS DYNASTY, both of which shifted ground.  Between the 500 Metres and the 350 Metres was held up for clear running.  Passing the 200 Metres was steadied when crowded between PRIME SUCCESS which shifted out when improving to the outside of EVERYONE’S STAR and COOL BOY (J Orman) which shifted in whilst being ridden along.  J Orman was advised to exercise more care.  C Y Ho stated that near the 500 Metres he felt his mount was being galloped on when WINNING GOLD shifted to the outside of ALL’S WELL.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

Near the 1100 Metres was steadied when crowded between EVERYONE’S STAR and SEWARD (Y L Chung) which lay in.  Whilst the Stewards accepted that Jockey Chung had made some effort to prevent his mount from shifting in he was advised to make a greater effort in similar circumstances.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.
No report.

Shifted in at the start and was bumped.  Near the 350 Metres was steadied when crowded between GALACTIC VOYAGE and MONARCH COUNTY (J Moreira) which, after improving to the inside of EVERYONE’S STAR, then shifted in further when being checked to avoid SEWARD which was giving ground.  Whilst the Stewards accepted that Jockey Moreria had taken evasive action to avoid SEWARD and then corrected his mount when it shifted in towards GLORIOUS DYNASTY, he was reprimanded and advised in similar circumstances he would be expected to make a greater effort to provide due care to his fellow riders.

K C Leung reported that his mount raced keenly when obliged to race wide and without cover for the majority of the event and as a result did not finish the race off in the Home Straight.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
Y L Chung stated that his instructions were to go forward and race outside the lead.
